name: Bump Stop Mounts
description:
Chassis specific mounts with both function and aesthetics in mind. These mounts are made specifically to fit the contour of the 120 chassis rear frame rails giving you a nice form fitting bump mount solution. 
Available in welded or non welded (bump stop cans not included)
Details:

(x2) mounts

(x2)16g stainless steel logo plates w/ hardware

Laser-cut 3/16" mild steel

Fits any 2" diameter bump stop

Keyed components for precise worry free assembly

(Optional) Strike Pad Details:

(x2) strike pads
Laser-cut 3/16" mild steel
1.00" or 1.75" from top of axle to strike surface
Integrated internal gusset for added strength

DISCLAIMER:
This mount is intended to be used with aftermarket shock mounting solutions. If intending to use with factory shock mounts, some clearancing may be required on the factory shock mounts near bump stop to utilize this kit. Little to no structural integrity is compromised for clearance. User discretion advised.





Vehicle Fitment:


2003-2022 Toyota 4Runner
2007-2014 Toyota FJ Cruiser
2003-2009 Lexus GX470
2010-2022 Lexus GX460

name: RiPouch™ Modular Velcro Panel
description:
Built from durable, high-quality materials for long-term use
Universal design mounts to campers, vehicle interiors, bed shells, and more
Install with Velcro backing or your own rivets
Sold individually, pouches not included

Introducing the RiPouch™ Modular Velcro Panel, a simple and versatile way to add modular storage anywhere you need it. Available in multiple sizes, each panel is designed to give you a clean, flexible mounting surface for RiPouch™ pouches and other hook-backed gear, making it easy to keep essentials organized, visible, and within reach.
Whether you are outfitting a camper, organizing the inside of a vehicle, adding storage to a bed platform, or creating a gear station in your garage or shop, the RiPouch™ Velcro Panel gives you the freedom to build a setup around your space and your needs. Different panel sizes allow you to choose the right fit for your application, whether you need a compact storage solution for a tighter area or a larger panel for carrying more gear.
Installation is simple and adaptable to the surface you are mounting to. Each panel includes stick-on loop-side Velcro for quick and easy installation on compatible smooth surfaces, while rivets can be used for a more permanent and secure install when needed. That flexibility makes the panel just as useful for temporary setups as it is for long-term builds.
At its core, the RiPouch™ Velcro Panel is about customizable organization. Instead of being locked into a fixed layout, you can attach, swap, and rearrange your pouches as your gear needs change. Use a single panel for a simple setup or combine multiple panels and sizes to create a more complete storage system for your vehicle, camper, trailer, or workspace.

name: 2019-2025 Rav4 Door Pillar Decals
description:
RAV4 Door Pillar Decal Kit (Set of 4) – Fits 2019–2025
Elevate Your Exterior. Eliminate Pinstriping.
Dull, scratched, or faded door pillars can make even the cleanest build look tired. Our RAV4 Door Pillar Decals are the easiest way to refresh your vehicle’s profile while adding a layer of durable protection. Designed with our signature Satin Finish, these decals transform those high-touch areas into a sleek, custom focal point. Whether you want a clean blackout look or a rugged topography pattern, these decals provide a precision-fit upgrade that stands up to the elements and hides fingerprints better than factory plastic.
Fits: 2019–2025 Toyota RAV4 (All Trims)

Why You’ll Love Them:


Complete Transformation: This kit includes 4 decals—two pairs for both driver and passenger sides—covering the surface of the front and rear door pillars.


Air Release Technology: Crafted from premium vinyl with micro-air-release channels, ensuring a bubble-free, smooth application even for beginners.


Customizable Style: Choose from our curated colors (like Satin Black or Topo) or go bold with a custom design to match your specific build theme.


Precision Offset: Each decal features a slight offset from the edges to prevent peeling and ensure long-term durability against weather and car washes.


Satin Finish: Our trademark finish provides a high-end look that hides wear and resists glare significantly better than standard factory trim.



📋 Compatibility & Fitment:


Fits: All 2019–2025 Toyota RAV4 models.


Surface Coverage: These are decorative overlays, not OEM replacement parts. They are designed to cover the flat top surface of the pillar and do not wrap down into the window seals or weather stripping.



⚠️ Critical Installation Info:


Dry Install Only: Do not use any liquids (soapy water or "wet" methods) during installation. This vinyl is designed specifically for dry application to ensure the air-release tech works properly.


Surface Prep: Clean the pillars thoroughly with Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) to remove all wax, ceramic coatings, and oils before applying.


Inspection: Please visually inspect all vinyl pieces for defects before removing the backing.


Professional Help: We are not responsible for installation errors. If you aren't confident in the process, your local vinyl shop can easily install these for you in minutes.


[🎥 WATCH THE FULL INSTALLATION VIDEO HERE]



Shipping & Policies:


Lead Time: Fast turnaround! Expect a 2–5 business day window for all prints.


Shipping Protection: 🛡️ Highly Recommended. Shipping can be rough on flat decals. Please add Route Protection at checkout; this covers the full cost of a replacement if your order is lost or damaged in transit.


Cancellations: All sales incur a 10% cancellation fee after 24 hours.


Questions about a custom pattern? Email us at support@tacovinyl.com.

name: OEO Angled Roof Rack Light Mount for Diode Dynamics Stage Series LED Rock Light
description:
OEO Angled Roof Rack Light Mount for Diode Dynamics Stage Series LED Rock Light (Single color or RGB). 
Engineered for optimal light positioning on roof-mounted systems, this 3D-printed mount delivers precision angles that maximize beam coverage across varied terrain.
SOLD INDIVIDUALLY
Includes:

1 - Angled Rock Light Mount
2 - 1/4"-20 stainless steel bolts - 2" long

Purpose-built to secure Diode Dynamics Stage Series LED Rock Lights, it integrates seamlessly with many standard roof rack brands and configurations. The durable ASA construction withstands extreme off-road conditions, UV light, and heat, while maintaining structural integrity through repeated off-road abuse. Ideal for expedition vehicles requiring reliable auxiliary lighting solutions that perform in demanding environments.
Utilizes heat set inserts to securely fasten the rock light with the center screw included in the Diode Dynamics Stage Series LED Rock Light kit. 
Featuring countersunk holes behind the rock light, this mount allows the use of existing crossbar mounting bolts on popular roof racks such as Sherpa, Victory 4x4, Prinsu, and other similar racks. We include a set of 2 - 1/4"-20 stainless steel bolts that are 2" long in case the crossbar bolts that come with your rack aren't long enough. (Do not overtighten bolts!)
If using in a different location or on a different rack, you can use the inlcuded 1/4" button head bolts and nuts (not included) to secure to any surface of your choosing. 
30 degree lighting angle.
Wiring channels on all four sides allow versatility for having the wire at the top, sides, or the bottom of the mount.
Rock Lights not included unless specifically selected. Rock lights may ship separately if purchased together.

name: JLU Base Plate System
description:
CargoKits Base Plate System is the foundation to your JLU's storage solutions.  Extrusion tracks in the floor allow gear to be bolted or strapped down using our hardware kits sold separately.  The Base Plate also is perfect for attaching drawer cabinets, and fridge slides as well.  The Base Plate System is sold in three parts, the Cargo Area Base Plate, the 60% Seat Delete Base Plate, and the 40%Seat Delete Base Plate.  The Cargo Area is the heart of the system and is required to add either Rear Seat Delete Base Plate.  Both the 60% and 40% can be installed with the remaining seat installed. 
Standard Features:

Extrusion Tracks in Floor for securing gear
Hatch access for all in floor storage
Side access to Seat Delete Base Plates
No Plywood used in the construction (Stainless Steel, Aluminum, HDPE)

name: 4Runner 6th Gen Dual Drawer Storage PreCut Kit - 2 Options
description:
This PreCut Kit fits the Toyota 4Runner 6th Gen [2025+]. 
You can choose between 2 options:
Base: Drawer System with no add-ons
Full: Drawer system, False Tops (2 Bamboo & 2 Metal), Bed Extension (60:40 Split), Dividers (4), Separators (2 Small - 2 Medium - 2 Large)
If you are interested in a more customized package, please visit solidwoodworx.com

Bed Extension is 60/40 split.
The 6th Gen non-hybrid kit specs:

Overall Outer Box Dims: 36.8 Long, 42.25 Wide, 13.2" High
Drawer Internal Dims: ~34.75 Long, 17.1” Wide, ~9.33” High
Dual Drawer with 32" Slides⁠ with 250lb lock-in, lock-out

Cubbies Included

The 6th Gen Hybrid kit specs:

Overall Outer Box Dims: 36.8 Long, 42.25 Wide, 8.25" High
Drawer Internal Dims: ~34.9 Long, 17.1” Wide, ~6.5” High
Dual Drawer with 32" Slides⁠ with 250lb lock-in, lock-out

Cubbies Included

You can choose between 3 options of false tops to turn each drawer into a cooking or workspace. Each drawer features multiple slots for removable dividers to organize your supplies. 
The whole system when installed weighs around 125lbs with the bed extension. We have cut out triangle reliefs around the outside of the box to drop weight, while keeping the structure strong! The bed extension is easily removable to use your 2nd row seats in less than a minute.
Crafted from high-quality, Hex-ply exterior birch core wood and precision CNC-cut, this kit ensures a smooth and stress-free building process.
If your 4runner has 3rd Row seat, this product will not work. We are currently working to develop this kit.
The kit will be shipped flat packed, when unpacking you will find all the precut wood pieces and hardware listed below needed to build your system in 1-2 hours.
Watch our build video to follow the step by step process to create this system. After built you can watch our install video on how to attach your system to the cargo area and bed extension.
Please have a look at our Fridge Slide!

SHIPPING AVAILABLE To continental USA - Inquire if not sure. CAN NOT ship to a PO BOX, please provide a physical address. Sent UPS GROUND. Please allow 5-8 business days for shipping and handling to receive your order.

name: Ineos - Grenadier - 2024-Present - 1st Gen - Venture Series - Roof Conversion Interior (RCI)
description:
Hello and welcome to the long-anticipated Roof Conversion Interior (RCI) for the Ineos Grenadier.
This product series is in a line called Venture Series and is defined by and internal extrusion frame as opposed to our current offering called the Explore Series which features items like our CampKitchen and drawer modules.
We will offer the kits in the following packages.1. Venture Series Roof Conversion Interior (RCI) RH Drawer Module, LH Sink Module and LH Water Module. $12,000.00. This kit will ship bare, without water or electrical options. It will not have any cutouts in the panels for electrical or water systems.2. Venture Series Rear Plate and Second Row Seat Delete, RH Drawer Module, LH Sink Module and LH Water Module. $14,000.00. This kit will ship bare, without water or electrical options. It will also not have any cutouts in the panels for electrical or water systems.3. Venture Series Roof Conversion Interior (RCI) RH Drawer Module, LH Sink Module and LH Water Module with Water and Power Systems. $17,000.00.4. Venture Series Rear Plate and Second Row Seat Delete, RH Drawer Module, LH Sink Module and LH Water Module with Water and Power Systems. $19,000.005. Custom built wire harness by Blaze Offroad, SAE Grade Connections using premium GXL wire where possible and premium connectors. Not knock off terminals or connectors.7. 50-amp Fused Power supply cable kit from factory second battery location to LH Sink Module interior with 50-amp Anderson Connector - 6 Gauge Main Power8. Ambassador Marine Sink9. Scandvik Water Faucet10. Whale Marine Hot Water Heater 12v 3 Gallon11. Whale Marine Water Pump with Expansion Tank 12v12. Whale Marine Water Fittings and Piping as Possible - Some items require flexible tubing.13. This kit will also include two custom mounting plates for the water heater and water pump for a 100% bolt on installation.Optional Shower Panel will include:1. Custom cut Bamboo mounting panel with hardware2. Scandvik Shower Mixer with On/Off Trigger Handle3. National Luna LED LightWhat to do if you already have the Goose Gear Grenadier Rear Plate and or Second Row Delete.1. If you have the rear plate, you can keep it, and everything will work just fine. The redesigned plate has a couple additional mounting points, and I have removed excess mounting locations as they are not needed. If you still want to replace your existing plate with a newer version the cost would be $400.00 with the purchase of an RCI interior kit.2. If you have the second row delete, there are two options.a. You can keep the existing second row delete, and the system will work just fine.b. If you purchase an RCI interior kit, we will give you the option to upgrade your second row delete for $500.00 and you can sell the old one on the used market for $800-$1,000 +/- fairly easily. If you choose this option, you will get a completely new second row delete with hardware. This is below my cost on this item, but we want you to have the option for the best possible build you can.
3. This is a one-time offer and only applies to the original purchaser of a seat delete or second row delete.

Providing a secure and stable place to strap your gear, or better yet, add some Goose Gear Drawers or IcBox Modules for superior storage and accessibility. Available storage space in the two storage compartments.

name: Jeep Wrangler 2024-Present JLU 4 Door - Second Row Seat Delete Plate System - V2
description:
New for the 2024 to current Jeep JLU's. For the 2024+ model years we have modified the support legs to fit with the new wiring locations and raised carpet that is found in newer model Jeeps. These seat deletes are the same overall design and fit as the Newly released V2 Seat Deletes, but have modified support legs to allow for the factory wiring relocation and additions.
This model is designed to fit into 2024-Present Model Year Vehicles.
Here are the Major Changes found in the V2 design:


Tighter fitting joints for a cleaner appearance.


Infill panel at doorway is now included in the design and has a tighter fit as well.


Center support leg is wider to create a better compartment divider.


Center support leg now has slotted mounting points for easier installation.


Front support leg has been widened and is a tighter fit as well.


Front support leg now has our new slotted pillow extension mounting points integrated.


This seat delete comes with the pillow extensions included.


Jeep Wrangler 2024-Present JLU Seat Delete Plate System for the Second Row is available to order for the 60% Passenger Seat and 40% Drivers Seat or can be combined to create a 100% second row delete.
Jeep Wrangler JLU Rear Plate System is required to install the Seat Delete Plate System.
The 60% Passenger Seat Delete Plate System is a bolt in replacement for the 60% rear seat delete. With this platform you get two storage access doors and all necessary hardware to bolt it to the vehicle at factory anchor points to attach it to the Jeep JLU Rear Plate System, no drilling required. If you are installing just the 60% delete you will need to own or purchase a 60% Seat Delete Bracket. This kit DOES NOT include the Jeep JLU Plate System, or the rear seat delete bracket.
Seat delete bracket can be found here
The 40% Driver Seat Delete Plate System is a bolt in replacement for the driver's side second row seat. With this platform you get two storage access doors and all necessary hardware to bolt it to the vehicle at factory anchor points without drilling and anchor points to attach it to the Jeep JLU Rear Plate System which is required to install the platform.
Second Row Seat Deletes require the Rear Plate System™ for installation. Plate System™ sold separately.
This Plate System is NOT compatible with the Jeep Wrangler 4xe.
The Goose Gear plate system and sleeping platform for the Jeep JLU are direct bolt in units and require no drilling into your vehicle for model years 2024+. Designed and built with industrial grade plywood and coating using our propriety spray methods for superior durability and wear resistance.
Also makes a great platform for securing your own storage or gear including dog crates, other fridge slide brands, etc. If you have or plan to run an Ursa Minor J30 this also makes a great stepping platform.
The factory 40% seat weighs 32 pounds.
The 40% Seat Delete weighs 21 pounds
The factory 60% seat weighs 63 pounds.
The 60% Seat Delete weighs 28 pounds.
40% Usable Space: Roughly 31" x 19" measured at the top of the plate. However, with the front seat back in the full back position with a typical seat recline, the usable space get reduced to 19" wide x 23" long. Not quite big enough for a typical 35-50 liter refrigerator. Unless you use the front seat in a much more forward position.
60% Usable Space: Roughly 31" x 34" measured at the top of the plate. However, with the front seat back in the full back position with a typical seat recline, the usable space gets reduced to 19" wide x 34" long. Due to the wider width, this product will accommodate a fridge sideways on the delete.

name: V2 Stealth Sleep Package for Jeep Wrangler 2021-2023 392
description:
With the all new V2 Jeep Wrangler 392 4 Door Stealth Sleep Package, you get the rear plate system as well as the complete second row delete system - turning the back of your Jeep into a flat and open storage and sleep solution. With ample storage below the second row delete you have storage at the lowest point in the interior which is great for Center of Gravity.  The Stealth Sleep package also comes with pillow extensions for the front of each seat delete, extending the length of sleep space to just over 72" - extensions store under seat delete when not in use.
This package includes the following:

Jeep Wrangler 392 Rear Plate System
Jeep Wrangler JLU Second Row Seat Delete Plate System - 40% Driver Side and 60% Passenger Side 

Unlike the Wrangler JLU, the 392 Rear Plate System does not allow for options for Subwoofer or Access Hatch, due to the fact the 392 comes equipped with a Factory Subwoofer and in-floor storage compartment only on the Passenger Side in the rear of the Jeep.
Please refer to the notes on each product page for additional information. Images shown are of the Subwoofer version and vary slightly from the non-subwoofer version.
This system is NOT compatible with the Jeep Wrangler 4xe.
V2 Interior seat deletes are not compatible with legacy V1 seat deletes

name: Ineos - Grenadier - 2024-Present - 1st Gen - Venture Series - Roof Conversion Interior Base Plate Package
description:
The INEOS Grenadier, Venture Series Base Plate Package for the Goose Gear Roof Conversion Interior is here and ready to set the foundation for your interior build.



This package includes the Rear Plate System as well as the Second Row Seat Delete Plate System designed specifically for the RCI.


Rear Plate System Features



This is a revised version of the existing Goose Gear Rear Plate System for the INEOS Grenadier.  This plate is designed specifically for the Roof Conversion Interior, such as the Alu-Cab Silenus Roof Conversion.
This system requires the removal of the rear factory floor liner and anchor points. Does not require cutting or drilling of any part of the vehicle. Once the plate is installed you now have a clean and flat surface. If you already have the existing rear plate system for your Grenadier, it will work with the Roof Conversion Interior perfectly. This redesign only added two additional anchor points for the RCI Modules and removed most of the unused anchor points that would simply be covered up in the RCI Interior. It is not a requirement for the RCI. But if you plan on purchasing the RCI and do not already own the rear plate, this is the model we would recommend.
Usable Space is approximately 41-5/8" (1058mm) Wide X 34-3/4" (885mm) Long
Plate Weight is approximately 27 pounds (12.2 kilograms)


Second Row Delete Plate System Features



The Ineos Grenadier - Venture Series Second Row Delete was designed specifically for the Venture Series - Roof Conversion Interior (RCI) such as the Alu-Cab Silenus Roof Conversion. If you have the original design Goose Gear second row delete you are still good to go for the Roof Conversion Interior. Upon the final design of the RCI we opted to create a second option that provides easier access to the storage space that resides behind the front row seats in the second row footwell. This reduction in plate length has opened up additional storage options and usability. If you are planning on installing a full RCI and already have the original design second row delete, please contact us to discuss your options for upgrading to the new design.
This 100% second row delete requires the removal of the seat, seat frame, and the surrounding plastic trim panels that house electrical components under the factory seat.
Key Features:

Rear Plate Required, this unit will work with either the original Explore Series Rear Plate or the new Venture Series Roof Conversion Interior Base Plate

Large Access Hatches: Convenient hatches allow easy access to batteries and other electrical components without removing the delete plate.

No Drilling or Cutting Needed: This system installs without any modifications to your vehicle, ensuring easy and straightforward installation.

Dimensions & Weight:

Usable space measures between 41-3/4” (1055mm) to 53” (1345mm) wide and 28-1/4” (715mm) long.
The plate weighs approximately 41 pounds (18.6 kilograms), with a weight savings of 83 pounds (37.6 kilograms) when replacing the factory rear seat, which weighs 124 pounds (56 kilograms).

Additional Features:

Creates a continuous, flat surface when paired with the Goose Gear Rear Plate System.
Custom-sized hatches provide easy access to electrical components.

name: Ford - Ranger - 2024-Present - Raptor - 1st Gen - T6.2 Platform - Explore Series - Second Row Seat Delete - 100%
description:
Now available for one of the best mid-size trucks ever made. The Ford Ranger Raptor second row seat deletes are designed for you to easily remove your rear seats and create a flat and secure platform for gear storage. The platform includes hatches that allow access to the factory storage space below the rear seats. In addition to the seat platform, you also get a back wall replacement that is secured to the platform, and the factory anchor points in the back wall.
The addition of the back wall gives you ample space to secure other gear, if necessary, such as fire extinguishers, first aid kits and other personal items.
Due to the configuration of the rear seat in the Ranger, this item is available as a 100% delete only as the bench seat is not like other vehicle models with a 60/40 or 50/50 split.
The factory subwoofer has to be removed from the vehicle or relocated by the end user at this time. This product does not have accommodations for the factory subwoofer box as found in Lariat and higher model Rangers. It does have a mounting position for the factory amplifier located in the lower right-hand corner of the driver's side back wall, as well as a mouse hole to chase the factory wires through. description:
FJ Cruiser Interior Door Skins (Set) 
Protect Your Panels. Personalize Your Interior.
Your FJ Cruiser was built for adventure, but the interior door panels often take the brunt of it. From muddy boots and trail gear to pets and tools, those plastic panels scuff easily, and those marks are permanent. Our FJ-specific Door Skins are engineered from our thickest, most durable sacrificial vinyl to act as a heavy-duty barrier that looks as rugged as the rest of your rig.
Fits 2007-2014 Fj Cruisers - Front and Rear Doors

Why You’ll Love Them:


🚚 Free Shipping: Get your interior protected with zero extra shipping costs.


Heavy-Duty Protection: Crafted from specialized, ultra-thick vinyl designed specifically for high-traffic interior plastics.


Preserve Resale Value: Keep your factory door panels in mint condition underneath the skin—perfect for high-use trail rigs.


Precision Fit: Every skin features a small offset from the panel edges to prevent lifting and ensure a long-term adhesive bond.


American Made: Proudly designed and manufactured in Boise, ID, USA.



Design Options:




Standard Designs: Clean, classic looks that ship within 5–7 business days.




Custom Designs: Want something unique? Select "Custom" and tell us your vision at checkout. We can do any pattern or color. (Note: Personal designs/logos may require a small setup fee).



⚠️ Critical Installation Info
To guarantee your skins stick for the long haul on the FJ's textured plastic, you must follow these requirements:


The "No Ceramic" Rule: These will not stick to interior panels that have been ceramic coated.


No Silicones: Do not use Armor All or silicone-based cleaners prior to install. These products prevent the vinyl from bonding.


The Prep: Use a heavy-duty degreaser followed by Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA). The plastic must be completely stripped of all oils and shine. If the panel is still "slick," it is not clean enough. 


Post-Heat (Mandatory): Once applied, you must post-heat all areas to 185°F with a heat gun to set the adhesive bond. This is the most vital step to prevent peeling in high-heat environments.

name: 2023+ Sequoia PPF Roof Rack Guard
description:
2023+ Sequoia PPF Roof Rack Paint Guards
Protect Your Roof. Prevent the Rust.
Installing a roof rack is one of the best upgrades you can do, but it comes with a hidden cost: paint damage. Most racks use rubber gaskets or feet that sit directly on your roof. Over time, vibration causes dirt, grime, and gravel to act like sandpaper, grinding through your clear coat. In our experience, we’ve even seen rust form on brand-new vehicles due to roof rack friction.
Our 12 mil Paint Protection Film (PPF) guards provide a heavy-duty, invisible barrier between your rack and your truck, ensuring your paint stays mint and your roof stays rust-free.
Why You Need Them:


🚚 Free Shipping: High-end protection delivered to your door at no extra cost.


Ultra-Thick 12 mil Protection: We use a specialized, extra-thick PPF that is significantly more durable than standard wrap vinyl, designed specifically to handle the weight and vibration of roof racks.


Rust Prevention: By sealing the paint surface, you prevent the metal-on-metal contact and moisture entrapment that leads to oxidation.


Precision Cut: Tailored specifically for the Sequoia roof line for a clean, professional look and easy alignment.


Maintain Resale Value: When it's time to sell or swap racks, your roof will look as good as the day it left the factory.



📋 Specifications:


Compatibility: Fits 2023+ Toyota Sequoia models.


Material: Heavy-Duty 12 mil Paint Protection Film (PPF).


Installation Method: Can be applied Dry or Wet (Wet install recommended for perfect positioning).



🛠 Installation & Support:


Easy Application: All you need is a small squeegee and a spray bottle with a tiny amount of soapy water (if opting for a wet install).


Step-By-Step Guide: Watch our [Installation Video Here] to see us perform a wet install on our Inferno Tacoma.


Surface Prep: Clean the roof thoroughly with a degreaser and Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) to ensure the PPF bonds permanently.


Pro Tip: Make sure the area is 100% free of dust before laying the film to ensure it remains invisible.

name: 2014-21 Tundra Door Skins
description:
2.5 Gen Tundra Interior Door Skins (Set)
Protect Your Panels. Personalize Your Interior.
Introducing the world’s first door skins for the 2.5 Gen Tundra. Your door panels take a beating from boots, tools, pets, and gear—leading to scuffs and wear that can hurt your truck’s resale value. Our skins are engineered from our thickest, most durable vinyl to act as a sacrificial barrier that looks as good as it performs. Whether you’re protecting a lease or customizing your forever truck, these skins are the ultimate interior upgrade.
Fits 14-21 Tundra Models - Double Cab/Crewmax only. Fronts will fit Access Cab Tundras

Why You’ll Love Them:


Heavy-Duty Protection: Crafted from specialized, ultra-thick vinyl designed specifically for high-traffic interior plastic.


Preserve Resale Value: Keep your factory door panels in mint condition underneath the skin.


Custom Built: Choose from our standard patterns or go fully custom with any design, color, or pattern you can imagine.


Precision Fit: Every skin features a 1/16" to 3/4" offset from the panel edges to prevent lifting and ensure long-term adhesion.


American Made: Proudly designed and manufactured in Boise, ID, USA.


Design Options:


Standard Designs: Clean, classic looks that ship within 5–7 business days.


Custom Designs: Want something unique? Select "Custom" and tell us your vision at checkout. We can do any pattern or color. (Note: Personal designs/logos may require a small setup fee).



⚠️ Critical Installation Info
To guarantee your skins stick for the long haul, please follow these requirements:


The "No Ceramic" Rule: These will not stick to interior panels that have been ceramic coated.


No Silicones: Do not use Armor All or silicone-based cleaners prior to install.


The Prep: Use a heavy-duty degreaser followed by rubbing alcohol. The plastic must be completely stripped of all oils and shine. If it is still shiny, it is likely not clean enough.


Post-Heat: Once applied, you must post-heat all areas to 185°F to set the adhesive bond. This is a vital final step.

name: 2025+ 4Runner PPF Roof Rack Guard
description:
Our 4Runner PPF Roof Rack Guards offer superior protection from wear and tear due to roof racks. Many roof racks feature a rubber gasket or similar element that touches the vehicle's paint. Over time, dirt, grime, and gravel can accumulate and cause damage to the vehicle's clear coat and, ultimately, the metal. In our experience, rust can form on new vehicles with roof racks installed early. Our 12 mil PPF guards offer excellent protection from such damage over the long term. If you're looking to maintain the paint of your vehicle and avoid any issues from utilizing a roof rack, this is a great product for you.  
Our 4Runner Roof Rack Guard is precisely cut to fit your vehicle for ease of installation. Installation is simple and requires a small squeegee and a small amount of soapy water if done wet. PPF can be applied dry or wet. Check out our installation video to see the process for our wet Install on an Inferno Tacoma.
If you have any question's about this product, email us at support@tacovinyl.com or call us at 208-697-4555. Thank you for your business. 
Any orders canceled after 24 hours will have a 10% cancelation fee. Thank you.

To guarantee your skins stick for the long haul, please follow these requirements:


The "No Ceramic" Rule: These will not stick to interior panels that have been ceramic coated.

description:
5th Gen 4Runner Topography Pro Grille (2014–2019)
The Best Fitment Meets Legendary Detail.
Elevate your 4Runner with the most precise Pro-style grille on the market, now featuring a permanent, custom-etched topographic map. Using high-precision CO2 laser technology, we etch the topography directly into the rugged ABS plastic. Unlike decals or wraps, this finish is permanent—it won't peel, fade, or wear off, even in the harshest off-road environments.
This is the ultimate upgrade for those who want a tight, gap-free fitment paired with a unique, adventure-inspired aesthetic.
Why You’ll Love It:


🚚 Free Shipping: Transform your 4Runner’s front end without the extra shipping cost.


Laser-Etched Topography: Precision CO2 etching creates a permanent, high-detailed texture that defines your build.


Superior Engineering: Designed to fit tighter than any other aftermarket option—no gaps and no factory components showing through.


Mechanical Security: Our letters are mounted with screws (not 3M tape) for maximum durability on the trail.


OEM Quality Build: Crafted from strong, matte black ABS plastic to withstand debris and UV exposure.


Complete Transformation: Replaces the upper grille portion and includes a cover shroud that adheres perfectly to the center bar.


Pro Tip (Weatherproof Wiring): Most fuse taps are too tall for the factory lid to close. To avoid cutting a hole in your OEM lid, we recommend adding an Engine Bay Fuse Box Riser from minwim3D to keep your electronics sealed and dry. (Only if you get raptor lights)



📋 Electrical & Compatibility
Powering Your Grille Lights:
When installing your lights, choosing the right power source is key to vehicle health. We recommend tapping into the IGN (Ignition) fuse rather than the INJ (Injector) fuse.


The IGN Fuse: This is the safest route. It tells the truck to turn your lights on with the key without interfering with how the engine runs.


The INJ Fuse: This is the "brain" of your engine. Tapping here is risky; if a fuse pops, it could stall your engine or trigger "limp mode."


Year-By-Year Compatibility:


2014–2019 Models: Fully compatible with safety sensor configurations.


2020–2024 Models: Includes the specific cutout and housing for the TSS Sensor.

name: 2024+ Tacoma PPF Roof Rack Guard
description:
Our Tacoma PPF Roof Rack Guards offer superior protection from wear and tear due to roof racks. Many roof racks feature a rubber gasket or similar element that touches the vehicle's paint. Over time, dirt, grime, and gravel can accumulate and cause damage to the vehicle's clear coat and, ultimately, the metal. In our experience, rust can form on new vehicles with roof racks installed early. Our 12 mil PPF guards offer excellent protection from such damage over the long term. If you're looking to maintain the paint of your vehicle and avoid any issues from utilizing a roof rack, this is a great product for you.
Our Tacoma Roof Rack Guard is precisely cut to fit your vehicle for ease of installation. Installation is simple and requires a small squeegee and a small amount of soapy water if done wet. description:

Specifications:

Sleek powder coated aluminum grille that clips into the factory bumper
Comes in two pieces. Both pieces are made of aluminum to cut weight, allow for some degree of flexibility, and the no rust factor. 
The two aluminum sections of the grille are powder-coated semi gloss for protection and the hardware is all stainless steel.

Installation:
Comes in two pieces. The first is a mounting frame that clips onto the factory bumper. There are several slots that will be pressed and clipped into place so that the main face of the grille can be mounted to it. The main grille then allows 18 bolts to pass through it to mount to the frame. Between the two aluminum pieces, rubber spacers will be added to prevent rubbing and allow the grille to be pushed into a more aesthetic position. The bolts will go through the main piece, the spacer will be added and then the bolt will tighten into a pre-mounted nut on the surface of the frame part of the grille. The last part is six bolts that hold the factory plastic piece of the upper bumper into place like the stock grille. Once the last six bolts are fastened the grille install is complete and the bumper is ready to go back onto the Rav4.

name: Track Bolt Kit
description: Kit includes 4 Roll in 10-32 Thread T-Nuts, 4 3/8 Aluminum Spacers, and 4 10-32 SS 3/4" Machine Screws.  Installation is a snap, roll the T-Nut into the track, insert a spacer above the T-nut in the cutout in the plastic, and tighten the screw to secure your gear.  It is possible to adjust anchor location by loosening the screen enough to slide the assembly in the linear tracks.

name: Threaded Insert Kit
description: The Threaded Insert Kit has the necessary hardware to install a metal threaded insert into your CargoKits Plastic Decking Material.  The Hardware includes (4) 1/4-20 threaded inserts, and (4) 5/8" Stainless Steel Machine Screws.  Installation is simple, drill a 3/8" hole in the desired location, slightly chamfer the holes edge with a counter sink bit, and thread the insert into the hole until it is flush with the surface.  I the insert tightens down and is not flush you need to chamfer the hole a bit more.  This Kit allows you to secure gear if it does not line up with the extrusion tracks.

name: The Brite Box High Beam & Fog Light Mod for Tundra (2022-2025)
description:
The Brite Box High Beam & Fog Light Mod for Tundra (2022-2025) is a device that mounts securely in the engine bay and greatly contributes to driving safety on dark roads by improving both the output and coverage of high beam mode. With The Brite Box Anytime, you'll gain full control of your fog lights and be able to operate them on any light setting such as no headlights, with daytime running lights and with high beams. The Brite Box Anytime requires an additional switch and includes a stylish universal switch that can be mounted anywhere with 3M double sided tape. Upgrade to an OEM style push switch for a factory look. With Brite Box, you can enjoy the benefits of these improved beam patterns, without placing any additional loads on the vehicle's stock headlight switches or wiring. Made in the USA!
2022-2025 Tundra
On the 2022-2025 Tundra the low beams will stay on but the fog lights will automatically shut off on high beams.


Option 1: The Brite Box Anytime - gives you full control of your fog lights. This kit will allow you to turn your fog lights on in any light setting such as no headlights, with daytime running lights, and with high beams.  

The Brite Box Anytime REQUIRES A SWITCH to turn your fog lights on at any time. When purchasing The Brite Box Anytime, it will include a Universal Switch (with a Blue LED). Upgrade to an OEM Style Push Switch here.
The Brite Box works with Aftermarket Headlights and Fog Lights!

name: Bulbzilla High Output Bulb Kits
description:
This Bulbzilla High Output Bulb Kits product manufactured by Aspire Auto Accessories allows you to easily place a 9005 bulb into any light that uses a 9006 bulb or easily place a H9 bulb into any light that uses a H11 bulb.
9006 and H11 bulbs are commonly used in low beams and fog lights. 9005 and H9 bulbs are commonly used in high beams. Replacing a 9006 bulb for a 9005 bulb gives you a 70% increase in output! Replacing a H11 bulb for a H9 bulb gives you a 60% increase in output!
Lumen Difference (Varies on Bulbs)
Before Bulbzilla
9006 output ≈ 1000 lumens
H11 output ≈ 1250 lumens
After Bulbzilla 
9005 output ≈ 1700 lumens
H9 output ≈ 2000 lumens
Features
• Kit will convert two bulbs
• Easy installation with no modifications to the vehicle
• High-Temperature Connectors with Moisture Seals 
• Option to add two bulbs (Philips H9)
• No other modification that gives you so much bang for the buck!
This Product Fits the Following
• Any vehicle with 9006 low beams or fog lights
• Any vehicle with H11 low beams or fog lights
How to Find My Bulb
No one wants to be the person who orders a kit that doesn’t fit. Luckily, we have all the info you need to prevent that from happening.
Bulbzilla kits are sold by bulb size; you’ll need to know what bulb sizes your vehicle uses. Your vehicle owner’s manual has that information, so simply check in there if you still have it. Don't want to search for the owner's manual or don't have one? Reach out to our team by online chat, phone, or email and one of our specialists will help. 
You can also search up your car year/make/model on the Philips site, which has a comprehensive list of all cars and their bulb sizes. 
Here’s the link to that: https://www.automotivebulbfinder.com/philips/
Frequently Asked Questions
Q: What exactly is Bulbzilla?
A: Bulbzilla is a bulb conversion kit that allows you to swap your low beams or fog light bulbs (whatever is applicable) to brighter bulbs which gives you approximately 60-70% more lighting output in lumens.
Q: How does the output of Bulbzilla compare to that of high power (over-wattage) low beam or fog light bulbs?
A:  An 80-watt high power 9006 bulb emits 1,750 Lumens of output. A 65 watt 9005 emits 1,700 Lumens. The stock H9 compared to a high-powered H11 also exhibits nearly equal output. For all intents and purposes, they are equally bright. BUT . . . the over wattage bulb has a LOT of disadvantages - see next question below.
Q:  Does using Bulbzilla have any advantages over high power (over wattage) low beam or fog light bulbs?
A: As stated above, the performance of a stock wattage 9005 / H9 is indistinguishable from an over-wattage 9006 / H11. Using the stock bulb produces LESS heat AND PROVIDES LONGER LIFE. Over wattage bulbs typically last NO MORE THAN 150 HOURS! Stock bulbs easily last twice as long and in most cases cost less than over-wattage bulbs. In the long run, Bulbzilla is the most cost-effective and EFFICIENT way to get more light. In vehicles, electrical power is obtained by the alternator converting FUEL energy into ELECTRICAL energy. The reduced wattage requirements of using a 9005 or H9 with Bulbzilla may not save a lot of fuel, but it does save some - and we all know that every drop counts!
Q: Can I use a Bulbzilla with Brite Box?





A: Yes, you can use Bulbzilla with any Brite Box system that is set up for a 9006 or H11 bulb.


Q: Does Bulbzilla blind oncoming traffic?

A: After installing Bulbzilla, your lights will still be properly aimed and will not be offensive to oncoming traffic. Even though a 60 - 70% increase in output sounds like a lot, a Bulbzilla equipped vehicle still will not negatively impact drivers from behind or oncoming traffic.




 
Q: Is Bulbzilla difficult to install and how long does it take?




A: Bulbzilla is well within the scope of the average consumer to install, ultimately all you are doing is changing a pair of light bulbs.  The actual replacement and conversion of the headlight or fog light bulbs takes approximately a half-hour with Bulbzilla. What varies is what procedure is required by the vehicle manufacturer to change the light bulbs.







Q: Do I have to modify my headlights or wiring with Bulbzilla and can I go back to stock bulbs?




A: There are absolutely NO modifications to any part of the vehicle's headlights or wiring with Bulbzilla. Since Bulbzilla requires zero modifications to the vehicle, you can reuse your stock 9006 or H11 bulbs at any time.








Q: How many adaptors or bulbs does the kit come with? 



A: A Bulbzilla kit includes two adaptors and two bulbs (if purchased with kit) to help complete the conversion. To use Bulbzilla on both low beams and fog lights you must order two kits.

Low Beam Daytime Running Lights (+$30.00) - Select this option if your vehicles uses the low beam for daytime running lights and we will add a custom made circuit to allow the harness to function properly.

High Beam Daytime Running Lights (+$30.00) - Select this option if your vehicle uses the high beam for daytime running lights  and we will add a custom made circuit to allow the harness to function properly.


 

Why use a Heavy Duty Relay and Headlight Wiring Harness Upgrade?

Reason #1: To minimize the VOLTAGE DROP in factory headlight systems. Voltage drop lowers the energy delivered to your headlight filaments which reduces their output. Voltage drop is a result of electrical power being run for long distances through thin wires. You can visualize voltage drop by imagining yourself drinking a beverage through a long thin straw (electric energy is the "beverage" and the wire is the "straw"). 
Reason #2: Using a H4 9003 HB2 Heavy Duty Relay and Wiring Harness Upgrade reduces the current that is handled by the head light switch by a large margin. This reduction in current greatly increases the life of your head light switch.
For example: Your factory headlight systems POWER flows from BATTERY to HEAD LIGHT SWITCH in passenger compartment. When head light switch is turned on, POWER flows back out into engine compartment and then illuminates HEAD LIGHTS. Notice the long distance that power must travel. To make matters worse, typical factory headlight wires are 18 Gauge or LESS. These long runs of thin wires starve your head lights of energy.
 
ADDING A 9007 HB5 HEADLIGHT WIRING HARNESS UPGRADE WITH RELAYS 
Increases the power delivered to your head lights by minimizing the distance power must flow from battery to head lights AND by passing this power through thick, 14 Gauge or 12 Gauge USA made wire (Smaller Gauge = THICKER wire) with the highest quality copper conductor. 
 
AFTER INSTALLING A 9007 HB5 HEADLIGHT WIRING HARNESS UPGRADE WITH RELAYS 
POWER flows from BATTERY to HEAD LIGHT SWITCH in passenger compartment. When head light switch is turned on, POWER flows back out into engine compartment and then ACTIVATES RELAYS on the wiring harness. The RELAYS then CONNECT the HEAD LIGHTS DIRECTLY to BATTERY through 14 Gauge or 12 Gauge wires.
In simplified terms, the 9007 HB5 Heavy Duty Headlight Wiring Harness with Relays Upgrade is triggered by the head light switch and when triggered, the harness supplies power to the head lights through a more efficient path.

name: 9008 H13 High Temperature Connector Socket 572º F / 300º
description:
At Aspire Auto Accessories we carry our own high temperature connectors that can withstand high temperatures and prevents melting. Manufactures equip vehicles with plastic versions of headlights plugs which are prone to melting over periods of time or due to excessive use at night. We offer the best quality connectors, with competitive pricing and free shipping on all headlight connectors and replacement pigtails. We have these connectors readily available and our manufacturing capabilities allow you to build your connector exactly how you want unlike most sellers.
Choose from 14 Gauge or 12 Gauge Headlight Wires - Our wire is USA made. Don't settle for import wire! Import wire typically has extra thick insulation that makes the copper "under gauge"! Additionally, most import wire we see has very poor quality copper.
Step 1: Select Wire Length


Unassembled - Terminals and Seals ONLY (Included) - When selecting this option you receive no wire with your purchase and must source your own.
6 Inches (+$1.00) - Our standard wire length

24 Inches (+$3.00) - Upgrade and extend your wire length of the connector
36 Inches (+$4.00) - Upgrade and extend your wire length of the connector

Step 2: Select Power Wire Gauge


14 Gauge (Included) - Our standard wire gauge

12 Gauge (+$5.00) - Upgrade your wires that goes to the headlight bulb and factory harness to thicker wire.

Step 3: Soldered Connections

No (Included)

Yes (+$1.50 per wire) - Have us solder your machine crimped connections so you can have the most secure & reliable harness. Solder is NOT common in vehicles, but is routine in aircraft because it produces the best union of wire to terminal.

Additional Information: Connector Type


High Temperature Connectors with Moisture Seals (Included) - Maximum Temperature = 572º F / 300º C 

All connections are machine crimped to the highest industrial standards.

name: Door Clean Up Kit For 4Runner / Tacoma / RAV4

name: 9004 HB1 to 9007 HB5 Heavy Duty Headlight Wiring Harness with Relays Upgrade
description:
Connect your vehicles headlight bulbs to FULL BATTERY VOLTAGE for MAXIMUM BRIGHTNESS! At Aspire Auto Accessories, we manufacture and carry our own Heavy Duty Wiring Harnesses with Relays that fit a wide selection of bulbs commonly found in most vehicles. 
This relay and wiring harness upgrade is one of the most simple and effective ways to improve dim headlights and overall headlight performance by increasing both your low beam and high beam illumination. Perfect for dark roads, off-road, and rural areas! 
Can't find a harness that fit's your vehicle's bulbs or unsure about product fitment? If you have any questions, please let us know and we'll be happy to help! 
 Features

This kit is designed to fit vehicles equipped with 9004 HB1 bulbs and converting to a headlight that uses 9007 HB5 bulbs
Gives you brighter low beam and high beam 
All connections are machine crimped and shrink wrapped to the highest industrial standards.
Harness is covered with premium split-loom covering to protect wires
High Temperature Connectors with Moisture Seals - Max Temperature = 572º F / 300º C

Build Your Harness
Select Wiring Harness Gauge &  Power Wire Gauge


14 Gauge (Included) - Our standard wire gauge

12 Gauge Wiring (+$20.00) - Upgrade your headlight wire that goes to the harnesses relays and your vehicle's headlights to thicker wire.


12 Gauge Fuse Holder (+$10.00) - Upgrade your power wire that goes to the harnesses relays and your vehicle's battery to thicker wire.

Soldered Connections

No (Included)

Yes (+$20.00) - Have us solder your machine crimped connections so you can have the most secure & reliable harness. Solder is NOT common in vehicles, but is routine in aircraft because it produces the best union of wire to terminal.

Select Daytime Running Lights 


No Daytime Running Lights - Select this option if you disabled your daytime running lights or if your vehicle does not have low beam or high beam daytime running lights


Low Beam Daytime Running Lights (+$30.00) - Select this option if your vehicles uses the low beam for daytime running lights and we will add a custom made circuit to allow the harness to function properly.

High Beam Daytime Running Lights (+$30.00) - Select this option if your vehicle uses the high beam for daytime running lights  and we will add a custom made circuit to allow the harness to function properly.


 

Why use a Heavy Duty Relay and Headlight Wiring Harness Upgrade?

Reason #1: To minimize the VOLTAGE DROP in factory headlight systems. Voltage drop lowers the energy delivered to your headlight filaments which reduces their output. Voltage drop is a result of electrical power being run for long distances through thin wires. You can visualize voltage drop by imagining yourself drinking a beverage through a long thin straw (electric energy is the "beverage" and the wire is the "straw"). 
Reason #2: Using a 9004 HB1 to 9007 HB5 Heavy Duty Relay and Wiring Harness Upgrade reduces the current that is handled by the head light switch by a large margin. This reduction in current greatly increases the life of your head light switch.
For example: Your factory headlight systems POWER flows from BATTERY to HEAD LIGHT SWITCH in passenger compartment. When head light switch is turned on, POWER flows back out into engine compartment and then illuminates HEAD LIGHTS. Notice the long distance that power must travel. To make matters worse, typical factory headlight wires are 18 Gauge or LESS. These long runs of thin wires starve your head lights of energy.
 
ADDING A 9004 HB1 to 9007 HB5 HEADLIGHT WIRING HARNESS UPGRADE WITH RELAYS 
Increases the power delivered to your head lights by minimizing the distance power must flow from battery to head lights AND by passing this power through thick, 14 Gauge or 12 Gauge USA made wire (Smaller Gauge = THICKER wire) with the highest quality copper conductor. 
 
AFTER INSTALLING A 9004 HB1 to 9007 HB5 HEADLIGHT WIRING HARNESS UPGRADE WITH RELAYS 
POWER flows from BATTERY to HEAD LIGHT SWITCH in passenger compartment. When head light switch is turned on, POWER flows back out into engine compartment and then ACTIVATES RELAYS on the wiring harness. The RELAYS then CONNECT the HEAD LIGHTS DIRECTLY to BATTERY through 14 Gauge or 12 Gauge wires.
In simplified terms, the 9004 HB1 Heavy Duty Headlight Wiring Harness with Relays Upgrade is triggered by the head light switch and when triggered, the harness supplies power to the head lights through a more efficient path.

When head light switch is turned on, POWER flows back out into engine compartment and then illuminates HEAD LIGHTS. Notice the long distance that power must travel. Increases the power delivered to your head lights by minimizing the distance power must flow from battery to head lights AND by passing this power through thick, 14 Gauge or 12 Gauge USA made wire (Smaller Gauge = THICKER wire) with the highest quality copper conductor.

POWER flows from BATTERY to HEAD LIGHT SWITCH in passenger compartment. When head light switch is turned on, POWER flows back out into engine compartment and then ACTIVATES RELAYS on the wiring harness. The RELAYS then CONNECT the HEAD LIGHTS DIRECTLY to BATTERY through 14 Gauge or 12 Gauge wires.
In simplified terms, the 9007 HB5 Heavy Duty Headlight Wiring Harness with Relays Upgrade is triggered by the head light switch and when triggered, the harness supplies power to the head lights through a more efficient path.

name: CS144 Alternator Swap Harness 1993–1997 Toyota Land Cruiser / LX 450 (1FZ-FE)
description:
If you’re upgrading your 80 Series to a CS144 high-output alternator, this harness makes the wiring portion of the swap clean, simple, and reliable.
The factory charging system on the 1993–1997 Land Cruiser and LX450 uses a Toyota oval 3-pin connector (IG–S–L). Most CS144 alternators use a GM-style regulator plug, which usually means cutting and splicing your factory wiring. This plug-and-play adapter eliminates the guesswork and lets you connect your high-output alternator the right way — no hacked wiring under the hood.

Whether your build includes a winch, dual batteries, lighting, onboard air, a fridge, or a full overland electrical system, a CS144 upgrade helps your 80 Series keep up with modern electrical demands — especially at idle.

Built in-house by TEQ Offroad for Land Cruiser owners who actually use their rigs. Finished in classic Toyota retro colors as a small nod to the heritage — even when you’re running GM charging power.

Features


Plug-and-play CS144 alternator adapter harness


Converts Toyota 3-pin (IG–S–L) to GM CS144 regulator connector


No cutting or splicing required


Clean, factory-style installation


Built for off-road and high-vibration environments


Ideal for high-output alternators (140–200+ amps)



Vehicle Fitment
1993–1997 Toyota Land Cruiser (FZJ80)
1996–1997 Lexus LX450


1FZ-FE 4.5L inline-6


Requires factory oval 3-pin Denso alternator connector


Does not fit 1991–1992 FJ80 (3F-E).

Note
This harness covers the wiring portion of the CS144 swap. Mounting brackets and pulley alignment modifications may vary depending on your alternator setup.

Why Upgrade to a CS144?
The factory alternator is typically 80–100 amps. Once you add modern accessories, charging performance — especially at idle — becomes a limitation.
A CS144 provides:


Higher output at idle


Support for winches and dual battery systems


Stable voltage for overland accessories


Proven durability for expedition and off-road use



Built for Land Cruiser Owners
At TEQ Offroad, we design parts the way we’d want them on our own trucks — simple, durable, and made to work the first time. No shortcuts. No unnecessary complexity. Just a clean solution for a common 80 Series charging upgrade.

Clean, factory-style installation


Designed for reliability in off-road and high-vibration environments


Perfect for high-output alternator upgrades (140–200+ amps)



Vehicle Fitment


1996–2002 Toyota 4Runner (3rd Gen)


5VZ-FE 3.4L V6


3RZ-FE 2.7L 4-cylinder

A CS144 provides:


Higher output at idle


Support for winches and dual battery systems


Stable voltage for lights, compressors, and overland gear


Proven reliability in demanding off-road builds



Built for Toyota Owners Who Love Offroading

name: Soft Shackle Block 2.5"
description:
Agency 6 Soft Shackle Block
 
Engineered for high-strength recoveries and maximum compatibility, the Agency 6 Soft Shackle Block is purpose-built for use with synthetic soft shackles and larger 7/8” D-ring shackles. Precision CNC machined in the USA from solid 6061 T6 aluminum, this block features a smooth, oversized opening designed to minimize wear on woven shackles during use.
 With a massive 19,000 lb Working Load Limit (WLL), this new generation block is stronger, more versatile, and better suited for today’s recovery gear setups. Its contoured edges and refined geometry ensure seamless integration with your soft shackle system—no sharp corners, no guesswork.

Important: Always use the lowest Working Load Limit (WLL) in your recovery setup as your maximum safe load (vehicle, receiver, shackle, etc).
 
Proudly Made in the USA.

name: Always-On Rear Window Switch Harness for 3rd Gen 4Runner (1996–2002)
description:
Unlock full control of your rear window anytime, without turning the key.
This Always-On Rear Window Switch Harness Kit is a 100% plug-and-play solution for 3rd gen Toyota 4Runners, allowing you to roll the rear window down whenever you want, engine on or off. No splicing. No cutting. No guessing.

This harness uses OEM-style connectors that plug directly into the factory wiring and piggy-backs off the original connectors. There is absolutely no cutting or splicing of factory wires required. Your original wiring remains fully intact and reversible.

Problem: Splicing into OEM wiring is unreliable, can cause intermittent failures over time, and permanently damages factory wiring. This harness avoids all of that by plugging straight into the original connectors the way it should.

The extra-long harness measures over 130 inches, giving you the freedom to mount the included switch virtually anywhere in the rear of the vehicle. Our favorite location is near the rear 12V outlet, but the length allows for many clean mounting options depending on your setup.

Installation is extremely simple. Just unplug the factory connectors, plug this harness in-line, mount the switch, and secure the wiring using the included zip ties. No special tools or wiring experience required.

What’s included:
Always-On rear window wiring harness
Window Switch
Zip ties for clean installation

Vehicle compatibility:
Toyota 4Runner 3rd Gen (1996–2002)

Perfect for camping, tailgating, overlanding, airflow, and everyday convenience — all without compromising your factory wiring.

name: Toyota Antenna Adapter
description:
Trail Grid Pro Toyota Antenna Adapter — Plug-and-Play OEM Antenna Retention
The Trail Grid Pro Toyota Antenna Adapter makes upgrading your factory radio simple while preserving proper AM/FM reception. Designed to connect your aftermarket head unit to the factory antenna cable, this adapter ensures a clean, reliable signal without cutting or splicing wires.
Built for select 2009-up Toyota vehicles (and compatible Lexus, Subaru, and Scion applications), this adapter features a standard male Motorola plug on one end and a female Molex connector on the other—making it a direct, vehicle-specific solution for modern Toyota platforms.
Simple Installation, Factory Functionality
This antenna adapter includes a blue power wire that must be connected to the antenna turn-on or power antenna lead on your aftermarket stereo. This powers the factory antenna amplifier to ensure strong radio reception.

Rear Left + Green

JBL Amplified or Non-JBL Amplified?

If you have a JBL logo on the top of your door speakers then you have a JBL Amplified System.
If you don’t have a JBL logo on your door speakers but you have an amplifier under your drivers side or passenger side seat then you have a non-JBL Amplified System.
If you do not have a JBL logo on the top of your door speakers nor have an amplifier under your drivers side or passenger side seat then you have a Non-Amplified System.

The package includes everything you need for a smooth installation: the Tundra Non-JBL amplified bypass harness, 10 wire ferrules, and 10 fork terminals. These additional connectors are included for compatibility, allowing you to connect easily to whichever amplifier you choose. Wire ferrules help ensure a secure and reliable connection to the amp’s terminals, while fork terminals provide flexibility in case your new amplifier’s input requires them. With these components, you'll have the adaptability to set up a reliable, high-quality connection for your amplifier, maintaining system performance without compromising on quality.
Our bypass harness is a plug-and-play solution that respects your vehicle’s original wiring, allowing for easy installation and removal if needed. By bypassing the factory JBL amp, you’re free to tap into your new amplifier’s full potential, unlocking richer sound and deeper bass.
Whether you’re a DIY enthusiast or prefer a professional install, our Amplified non-JBL Bypass Harness package has you covered, making it easy to enhance your sound system without the hassle. Upgrade your 2014-2021 Tundra non-JBL-amplified-equipped vehicle with confidence, knowing you have a reliable solution that maintains both performance and the integrity of your vehicle’s wiring.

name: 4-Gauge Amplifier Wiring Kit
description:
Power Your System the Right WayTrail Grid Pro's 4-gauge amplifier wiring kit provides all the necessary components to safely and efficiently power your amplifier.
Power Ratings and EfficiencyAmplifiers are typically categorized into two "Classes" with varying efficiencies and power wire size needs. Class AB amplifiers generally operate at 50% to 60% efficiency, while Class D amplifiers tend to be more efficient, ranging from 75% to 80%. This Trail Grid Pro wiring kit is designed to handle the energy needs of a Class AB amplifier with up to 700 watts RMS or a Class D amp with up to 1,100 watts RMS.
Trail Grid Pro Wire SolutionsCrafted from oxygen-free copper, Trail Grid Pro wire eliminates impurities that could impact signal flow or introduce interference. Our wire meets all Consumer Technology Association (CTA-2015) standards for size, resistance, and insulation quality, ensuring top performance for your system.
Product Highlights:

Complete wiring kit for power packs and high-power radios
RCA cables, remote turn-on lead, and speaker wire not included
Maximum power ratings: Class AB – 700 watts RMS, Class D – 1,100 watts RMS
Oxygen-free copper wires meet all ANSI and CEA standards

17 feet (5.2m) of 18 gauge blue remote turn-on wire
Brass mini-ANL fuse holder and two 50A fuses (100A total rating)
Assorted hardware included

4-gauge firewall bushing

Six wire ties

description:

We’re proud to offer a clean, factory-style solution for mounting your Alpine aftermarket microphone into the headliner console of your 2016–2023 Toyota Tacoma. This mount allows your microphone to be neatly integrated into the OEM location while maintaining excellent voice clarity and functionality.

Installation Instructions



Remove the Headliner Console

Gently pull down on the headliner console to release the pressure clips.
Use a plastic panel removal tool to avoid damage during removal.

Disconnect Console Wiring

Unplug the wiring harness connector from the console.

Remove Foam Insert

Locate the factory microphone port and remove the foam insert.

Install the Microphone into the Mount

Push the rounded end of the microphone through the opening of the mount.
Make sure the rounded end sits close to the bottom of the center mount support.


Mount the Assembly into the Console

Insert the mount into the headliner console with the legs and rounded end of the microphone facing down.
Press until the clip locks securely into place.

Route the Microphone Wire

Route the wire from the headliner console toward the rearview mirror.
Reinstall the console, pulling any slack toward the mirror.
Continue routing the wire across the top of the windshield, down the driver’s side A-pillar, and toward the floorboard.
Run the wire under the dash and plug the 3.5mm jack into the red microphone port on the back of your Alpine head unit.

Test the System

Power on the head unit and test the microphone to ensure it is working properly.

JBL Amplified or Non-JBL Amplified?

If you don’t have a JBL logo on your door speakers but you have an amplifier under your drivers side or passenger side seat then you have a non-JBL Amplified System.

Our bypass harness is a plug-and-play solution that respects your vehicle’s original wiring, allowing for easy installation and removal if needed. By bypassing the factory JBL amp, you’re free to tap into your new amplifier’s full potential, unlocking richer sound and deeper bass.
Whether you’re a DIY enthusiast or prefer a professional install, our JBL Amp Bypass Harness package has you covered, making it easy to enhance your sound system without the hassle. name: Sony Microphone Mount | '10 - '24 4Runner
description:
How to install your Mic Mount











































We are proud to offer you a solution for mounting your Sony aftermarket microphone in your 2010 – 2024 4Runner’s factory microphone location.
This allows your new microphone to be neatly tucked away in the headliner console and maintains the level of voice clarity and function you expect.
Installation Steps


Remove Headliner Console. Depending on trim level this may vary slightly. – If you have a sunglasses compartment, flip open the compartment and remove the 2 screws.OR– If you have terrain setting knobs (i.e., TRD Pro, Off Road, etc.), pull down/off the control panel which will reveal the 2 screws.– Front of headliner console is typically held in with pressure clips and can be removed by pulling straight down.


Remove Headliner Console Wiring Harness. Unplug harness connector.

Remove Factory Microphone. Locate microphone (black rectangle) and push toward the front of headliner console. This will remove the cover for the dome light switch cover and switch. Unplug the factory microphone and replace the dome light switch and cover.

Remove Mounting Ball On Microphone. The small ball can be removed easily by cutting with a pair or side cutters or a utility knife.

Install Microphone To Mount. Route the 3.5mm jack end through the bottom end of the mount. Pull all slack through and secure microphone into mount. Rounded end of microphone should be inline with 2 legs on mount.

Install Sony Microphone Mount. Install mount into headliner console. Insert mount (legs facing down) until the clip locks into place.

Route Microphone Wire. Start by routing microphone wire from headliner console area through headliner towards rearview mirror. At this point, you can re-install the headliner console. Be sure to pull excess slack toward the rearview mirror while reinstalling headliner console. Continue routing the wire along the top of the windshield toward the driver side A pillar. Tuck the wire behind the A pillar cover and route down the A pillar toward the drivers floorboard. Run the wire under the dash area and finish by routing the 3.5mm jack to the back of your new Sony Bundle. Connect the 3.5mm jack into the red mic port on the rear of the Sony radio chassis.

Test Functionality. Test functionality after making all required connections.

If equipped with terrain knobs (TRD Pro, Off-Road, etc.): Gently pull off the control panel to reveal the screws, then remove them.
Pull the front of the console straight down to release the pressure clips.

Disconnect Console Wiring

Unplug the wiring harness connector from the console.

Remove Factory Microphone

Locate the black rectangular factory mic.
Push it forward to release the dome light switch and cover.
Unplug the mic and reinstall the dome light switch and cover.

Mount the Alpine Microphone

Push the rounded end of the microphone through the opening of the mount.
Ensure the rounded end sits near the bottom of the center mount support.

Install the Microphone Mount into Console

Insert the mount into the headliner console with the legs facing down.
Push until it clicks securely into place.

Route the Microphone Wire

Run the wire from the headliner console toward the rearview mirror.
Reinstall the console while pulling any slack toward the mirror.
Continue routing the wire along the top of the windshield toward the driver’s side A-pillar.
Tuck the wire behind the A-pillar cover and run it down to the driver’s footwell.
Route the wire under the dash to the back of your Sony bundle.
Plug the 3.5mm jack into the red microphone port on the Sony radio chassis.

Test Functionality

Power on the system and confirm the microphone is functioning properly.

name: Sony Microphone Mount | '16 - '23 Tacoma
description:
How to install your Mic Mount


































We are proud to offer you a solution for mounting your Sony aftermarket microphone in your 2016 – 2023 Tacoma’s headliner console.
This allows your new microphone to be neatly tucked away in the headliner console and maintains the level of voice clarity and function you expect.
Installation Steps


Remove Headliner Console.– The headliner console is typically held in with pressure clips and can be removed by pulling straight down. It is recommended to use gently pressure with a panel removal tool to pry the headliner console out.

Remove Headliner Console Wiring Harness. Unplug harness connector.

Remove Foam Insert. Locate microphone port and remove the foam insert.

Remove Mounting Ball On Sony Microphone. The small ball can be removed easily by cutting with a pair of side cutters or a utility knife.

Install Microphone To Mount. Push the rounded end of the microphone thru upper support of the mount. The rounded end of microphone should be very close to in line with the bottom of the 2 legs on mount. Align the spot where you cut off the ball to be in-line with one of the upper supports. This will make sure the audio openings on the side of the microphone are not obstructed.

Install Sony Microphone Mount. Install mount into headliner console. Insert mount (legs & rounded end of microphone facing down) until the clip locks into place.

Route Microphone Wire. Start by routing microphone wire from headliner console area through headliner towards rearview mirror. At this point, you can re-install the headliner console. Be sure to pull excess slack toward the rearview mirror while reinstalling headliner console. Continue routing the wire along the top of the windshield toward the driver side A pillar. Tuck the wire behind the A pillar cover and route down the A pillar toward the driver’s floorboard. Run the wire under the dash area and finish by routing the 3.5mm jack to the back of your new Sony Bundle. Connect the 3.5mm jack into the red mic port on the rear of the Sony radio chassis.

Test Functionality. Test functionality after making all required connections.

name: Dash Camera Power Adapter | '05 - '23 Tacoma
description:
Toyota Tacoma Dash Camera Power Adapter Install

















What's My Pin Count? 
The pin count for your dash camera power adapter can vary depending on your vehicle. Here’s a quick guide to help you identify the right one:


7-pin: Typically found on 2003–2019 Toyota 4Runners with an auto-dimming rearview mirror. The adapter connects directly to the back of the mirror, no need to access the overhead console.

10-pin: Typically used in 2020–2024 Toyota 4Runners and is accessed via the vehicle’s overhead console.

12-pin: Typically associated with 2014+ Toyota Tundras, some 2010+ 4Runners and 2016–2023 Toyota Tacomas. These usually connect to the back of the rearview mirror. 

14-pin: Typically related to 2005–2015 Toyota Tacomas or 2007–2013 Toyota Tundras. These usually connect to the back of the rearview mirror. 

Again, this is a helpful guide but please be sure to check your vehicle's pin count before purchasing to ensure compatibility!
Dash Camera Power Adapter Overview
Details: Use our Dash Camera Power Adapter to plug your dash camera into the power connector on the back of your rearview mirror and you're up and running.
Plug & Play: The power adapter harness in our kit will plug directly into the power source for your factory rearview mirror. Check out the video above for details! Our kit takes about 10 minutes to install!
Plug & Play Compatibility: In order for this bundle to be compatible with your 4Runner it does require you have an auto-dimming rearview mirror or a rearview mirror with an LCD backup camera screen.
Included: 1x plug and play power harness, 1x USB-C to USB adapter, 1x micro-USB to USB adapter, 1x zip tie

name: Porsche Cayenne 2011-2017 2nd Gen. - Rear Plate System
description:

This is also a must for diesel powered Cayenne's as you will need access to add Blue DEF fluid.
By adding the Goose Gear Plate System™  you will now have the ability to easily and quickly add or remove various Goose Gear Modules. Including the IceBox Modules and drawer modules.

Weight: 26-28 pounds

You can also use the Goose Gear Plate as a base to mount or to secure your own fridge slide, cooler or refrigerator. There are also pre-installed anchor points which you can use to add Goose Gear Anchor Packs to utilize straps to secure your personal cargo.

name: Jeep Wrangler 4 Door Second Row Seat Delete Plate System - Infill Panels
description:
Jeep Wrangler Second Row Delete Infill Panels are compatible with both Wrangler JKU and JLU. Infill Panels can be added to the Seat Delete Plate System for those of you that would like to close in the opening at the second-row doors.  These panels are compatible with V1 seat delete SKUs 1035-GGR-SH 40% & 1036-GGR-SH 60%.
V2 seat deletes (SKU 1484-GGR-SH - 40% & 1485-GGR-SH - 60%) will come with infill panels as part of the system.  There is no need to order them separately, and the V2 panels are a different shape than the original V1 panels.  V2 Seat Deletes came on the market 02/01/25.
Designed to be 100% bolt on and easy to add with three 1/4-20x3/4" screws and three roll-in t-nuts and hardware to mount to your existing extrusion channel under the seat delete.
They are available as a single piece and they will fit either the 40% or 60% seat deletes. Also available to purchase as a pair if you already have the 40 and 60% deletes.
Jeep Wrangler JKU Seat Delete Plate Systems: JKUs will use these original Infill Panels, but due to minor changes in construction of our seat deletes, older models may not be able to use the third mounting hole towards the rear of the vehicle. This is still structurally sound and will still perform the function you are looking for but it will be with 2 bolts instead of 3 bolts.
This product is NOT currently compatible with the Jeep Wrangler 4xe. 
Infill Panels do not currently fit some 2024 and newer Wranglers with the Premium Cabin Package (due to thicker carpet, insulation and additional electrical wiring).
Legacy SKU's: PJKU/JLU-SRD-Infill-Each, PJKU/JLU-SRD-Infill-Pair

name: Goose Gear Strap Kit
description:
The Goose Gear Strap Kit is Made in the USA of domestic and imported materials.
The kit consists of 4 straps that measure 48" long with 1" wide webbing. Our webbing selection is Made in the USA, is UV stable and is a military grade product, yet is much thinner than the less expensive strap materials commonly found in imported strap kits. The cam buckle is also larger than most on the market for superior strength and ease of use.
We have also added a Velcro wrapping sleeve to secure the excess strap length for a clean installation. This also eliminate the need to cut the straps and melt the cut ends to prevent fraying. Additionally, since we are using the higher quality strap material, the excess strap rolls up into a thin roll for a clean and less cluttered installation.
The Kit includes 4 straps.
Strap testing as certified by Applied Technical Services, LLC an ISO 9001 Company, July 26, 2021 359287 - Average breaking force is 703 lbf.
Straps are not certified for overhead use and should never be used in this way. Maximum recommended use is 200 lbf. Do not use these straps on humans or animals or to secure humans or animals in any way.
Each strap weighs 3 ounces, pack of 4 weighs 1 pound

name: Toyota Sequoia 2008-2022 2nd Gen. - Rear Plate System
description:

Mounts to vehicle using existing holes and anchor points. No drilling or cutting required.
Featuring 4 lockable hatch doors using our compression latches, this plate is the first of its kind. This is due to the vehicle construction and layout. The plate sits approximately 8" above the base vehicle floor. With the 4 access hatches you can store your gear below and have plenty of room for additional storage on top. Additionally, you can utilize a wide selection of Goose Gear modules and install them onto the plate using the pre-installed anchor points.
Module depths up to 30" will still allow access to the forward access hatches. Perfect for our CampKitchen 2.1 or 2.2.
Due to the limited use of this vehicle in our industry, we have only been able to test fit into a model year 2011 Sequoia with Platinum Trim Level. Please verify whether this plate will or will not fit your vehicle prior to purchase. Review the pictures we have provided to ensure this unit will work with your model year and trim level. As we gain access to additional models we will most certainly add the models that work.
This is our largest and most complex interior plate to date and due to its size we are required to ship this product via truck freight. Price listed includes crating and shipping.
