name: Rivian - R1T - 2022-Present - 1st Gen - 4.5' Bed - Explore Series -  UltraLite - GFC
description:
Explore Series Ultra-Lite for GFC

Go Fast Campers (GFC) partnered with us to develop the ultimate interior for their V2 Pro Camper, specifically tailored to the Rivian R1T. Both companies share a vision of maintaining high standards by keeping all manufacturing in the USA, ensuring top-quality craftsmanship.
Upgrade your Rivian R1T with the Explore Series Ultra-Lite for GFC, a modular storage solution designed for versatility and ease of use. Whether you need secure storage, a flat work surface, or a fully configurable system, this setup allows you to customize it to fit your needs—all while maintaining access to the R1T’s under-bed spare tire storage.


CONFIGURATION OPTIONS

The Explore Series Ultra-Lite for GFC offers multiple configurations to match your setup:
✔ Bed Cargo Module – A secure, strap-in storage solution utilizing factory anchor points while preserving access to the under-bed spare tire compartment. Compatible with optional Step 22 Stingray Flat Box bags for enhanced organization.
✔ Bench and Storage Module - Driver Side – A flat-packable, lockable storage module that installs on the driver’s side.
✔ Bench and Storage Module - Passenger Side – The same versatile module, designed for the passenger side.
✔ Bed Cargo & Bench and Storage Module - Passenger Side Package – Combines the Bed Cargo Module with the Bench and Storage Module on the passenger side.
✔ Bed Cargo & Bench and Storage Module - Driver Side Package – A package including the Bed Cargo Module and Bench and Storage Module on the driver side.
✔ Bed Cargo & Bench and Storage Modules - Full Package – The ultimate setup, featuring the Bed Cargo Module along with Bench and Storage Modules on both driver and passenger sides for maximum storage and utility.

For added versatility, you can also integrate the Flat Deck Panels (SKU 1162-GGR-SH) to create a flush surface, perfect for additional workspace or securing gear. The MaxLite™ extrusion underneath adds strength and support for rugged adventures.

This system is designed to work seamlessly with the Rivian R1T’s factory bed lighting, ensuring visibility in all conditions. It also maintains easy access to key factory features, allowing you to open and access the under-bed gear tunnel and spare tire storage compartment without removing the system.
With a fully modular design, the Explore Series Ultra-Lite for GFC adapts to your needs—whether you’re gearing up for a weekend adventure or optimizing your truck for daily use. Configure it your way and take your setup to the next level.
Products shown inside modules are not included.

name: Toyota Land Cruiser 1991-1997 80 Series - Side x Side Drawer Module with Fitted Top Plate - 43-3/8" W x 8" H x 40" D
description:
The Toyota Land Cruiser 80 Series Side x Side Drawer Module is designed for easy access gear storage, with two large slide out drawers for all your smaller gear. This system can be added on to with our Second Row Seat Delete Plate System™ that are Module Height to make one large sleep platform.
This module requires the Land Cruiser 80 Series Rear Plate System™ for proper installation.
This Side x Side Modules is equipped with 8" tall drawers that are available in 50/50 split, 1/3-2/3 split and 2/3-1/3 split configurations. The 1/3-2/3 split have the smaller drawer on the left side of the module and the 2/3-1/3 split have the smaller drawer on the right side of the module.
This Land Cruiser Specific Module is sprayed with proprietary bed liner top plate for increased durability as well as a location to mount additional items such as anchors for fridge and cooler straps etc. The top plate is slightly narrower than the drawer top to allow the addition of Wheel Well Wings. The Wheel Well Wings extend over the wheel wells and enclose the space between the module and the outside edge of the vehicle interior. This creates a flat surface that runs from wall to wall, seat back to back door. The hatch doors use Blum Euro hinges and mount to the side profile of the Side x Side Module. They are adjustable and also feature a quick release mechanism for easy removal.
Specifications

Designed for the Toyota Land Cruiser 1991-1997 80 Series
Dimensions: 43 3/8" W x 8" H x 40" D
350# rated drawer guides with 34" of travel. We recommend no more than 100# per drawer.
Module and Top Plate weight: 125.4 pounds

description:
The Ford F250-F350 second row seat deletes for the Crew Cab 4 door are designed for you to easily remove your rear seats and create a flat and secure platform to secure your gear to. The platform includes hatches that allow access to the factory storage space below the rear seats. In addition to the base plate, you also get a back wall replacement that is secured to the base plate and the factory anchors points in the back wall.
This product is designed to match the factory seat layout: 

40% Passenger Side Seat Delete  with B&O Center Mounted Subwoofer 
60% Driver Side Seat Delete with B&O Center Mounted Subwoofer 

Run both Seat Deletes for a 100% Second Row Seat Delete
This unit is 100% bolt in and does not require drilling. This system is designed to work around the factory subwoofer.
The addition of the back wall gives you ample space to secure other gear if necessary, such as fire extinguishers, first aid kits and other personal gear.
For the design, we utilized our preferred design of 60/40 split. This design allows the user to add a fridge or cooler behind the passenger's seat in a front to back orientation. Keeping the 60% space wide open and usable. Fridge models that would easily fit in this space include:

National Luna Weekender 50 and 52, Legacy 40 and 52
Dometic CFX3 35, 45 and 55
ARB Classic 35, 47 and Zero 38 and 47
SnoMaster TR42 and CL40
Other fridge models can certainly fit in this space. our recommended maximum dimensions for this area are 28"w x 18"d x 22"h

Product Specifications: 

Product Weight

40% Seat Delete: 21 lbs. (5319)
60% Seat Delete: 32 lbs. (5027)



AIR BAG ISSUES
Air Bag Warning Light may be triggered. Below are photos of how one customer plugged in components that eliminated the air bag warning light on his higher end King Ranch Edition. We expect the same from the Platinum and Limited versions as well.

The seat belt coil and the black box, which has to be removed from the rear seat need to be plugged in to defeat the air bag warning light.

Please note: There is a possibility of airbag warning light activation for seat deletes installed on 2020-present Ford F150 and F250-550 Super Duty models, including King Ranch, Platinum, and Limited trims. The only way to eliminate the Air Bag warning light is to connect the seat belt coil and the small black box back into the factory plugs. This is a lot of stuff that now needs to be hidden away somewhere safe. We recommend wrapping it in something to keep it quiet and stuffing it under the seat delete towards the rear of the vehicle.

name: Alu-Cab Canopy Camper V2 - Ford Ranger 2019-2023 4th Gen. - Bed Plate System - 5' Bed
description:
The Alu-Cab Canopy Camper V2 Bed Plate System is the foundation of the Goose Gear Alu-Cab interior system. The Bed Plate System requires drilling into the vehicle bed for proper and safe installation. Once the Plate System is installed the user can easily add or remove AluCab Canopy Modules as needed. With integrated anchor points throughout the plate.
The Bed Plate System is base the Alu-Cab modules, but does not follow the contours of the bed walls. This system is designed and built with industrial grade plywood and coating using our propriety spray methods for superior durability and wear resistance.
The new series of modules for the Alu-Cab Canopy Camper are lighter and more efficient than previous models. By utilizing the Alu-Cab extrusion channels we have been able to eliminate the need for back leg supports for the Utility Modules. This change saves weight, money and shipping costs.
By tying the modules to the Canopy Camper, the installer is able to get a consistent flat surface between the Utility Modules and Drawer Modules. The installation process requires the user to install spacers onto the supplied brackets for proper leveling.

Whether you need secure storage, a flat work surface, or a fully configurable system, this setup allows you to customize it to fit your needs.


CONFIGURATION OPTIONS:

The Explore Series Ultra-Lite for GFC offers multiple configurations to match your setup:
✔ Bed Cargo Module – A secure, strap-in storage solution utilizing factory anchor points. Compatible with optional Step 22 Stingray Flat Box bags for enhanced organization.
✔ Bench and Storage Module - Driver Side – A flat-packable, lockable storage module that installs on the driver’s side.
✔ Bench and Storage Module - Passenger Side – The same versatile module, designed for the passenger side.
✔ Bed Cargo & Bench and Storage Module - Passenger Side Package – Combines the Bed Cargo Module with the Bench and Storage Module on the passenger side.
✔ Bed Cargo & Bench and Storage Module - Driver Side Package – A package including the Bed Cargo Module and Bench and Storage Module on the driver side.

With a fully modular design, the Explore Series Ultra-Lite for GFC adapts to your needs—whether you’re gearing up for a weekend adventure or optimizing your truck for daily use. Configure it your way and take your setup to the next level.

name: Ford - F150 2021-Present - 14th Gen. SuperCrew - Second Row Seat Delete Plate System with Factory B&O Subwoofer Center Wall with Exterior Port
description:
The Ford F150 second row seat deletes for the Super Crew 4 door F150 are designed for you to easily remove your rear seats and create a flat and secure platform to secure your gear to. The platform includes hatches that allow access to the factory storage space below the rear seats. In addition to the base plate, you also get a back wall replacement that is secured to the base plate and the factory anchors points in the back wall. 
This product is designed to match the factory seat layout: 

40% Passenger Side Seat Delete (5319)
60% Driver Side Seat Delete with B&O Center Mounted Subwoofer (5027)

Run both Seat Deletes for a 100% Second Row Seat Delete
This unit is 100% bolt in and does not require drilling. This system is designed to work around the factory subwoofer.
The addition of the back wall gives you ample space to secure other gear if necessary, such as fire extinguishers, first aid kits and other personal gear.
For the design, we utilized our preferred design of 60/40 split. This design allows the user to add a fridge or cooler behind the passenger's seat in a front to back orientation. Keeping the 60% space wide open and usable. Fridge models that would easily fit in this space include:

National Luna Weekender 50 and 52, Legacy 40 and 52
Dometic CFX3 35, 45 and 55
ARB Classic 35, 47 and Zero 38 and 47
SnoMaster TR42 and CL40
Other fridge models can certainly fit in this space. our recommended maximum dimensions for this area are 28"w x 18"d x 22"h

Product Specifications: 

Product Weight

40% Seat Delete: 21 lbs. (5319)
60% Seat Delete: 32 lbs. (5027)



AIR BAG ISSUES
Air Bag Warning Light may be triggered. Below are photos of how one customer plugged in components that eliminated the air bag warning light on his higher end King Ranch Edition. We expect the same from the Platinum and Limited versions as well.

The seat belt coil and the black box, which has to be removed from the rear seat need to be plugged in to defeat the air bag warning light.

Please note: There is a possibility of airbag warning light activation for seat deletes installed on 2020-present Ford F150 and F250-550 Super Duty models, including King Ranch, Platinum, and Limited trims. The only way to eliminate the Air Bag warning light is to connect the seat belt coil and the small black box back into the factory plugs. This is a lot of stuff that now needs to be hidden away somewhere safe. We recommend wrapping it in something to keep it quiet and stuffing it under the seat delete towards the rear of the vehicle.

In the middle of the unit, facing forward towards the drivers seat is a drawer  featuring 12" heavy duty drawer guides as well as a lockable compression latch. This unit measures 20"w x 13"d x 10"h Weight is 24#

Long System Specifications:

On the drivers side rear there is a drawer 48" featuring lock in / lock out drawer guides as well as a lockable compression latch. This unit measures 18"w x 54"l x 10"h Weight is 58#

Select Black or Gray Drawer Face

When the pillow extension is not in use, it can be secured to the front leg of the seat delete with the same thumb screws. Setup and teardown are less than a few minutes each.

The 10" version platforms will also work with the 28" Dometic Fridge Drawer 30-liter Module.

The 60% Passenger Seat Delete Plate System is a bolt in replacement for the 60% passengers' side second row seat. With this platform you get three storage access doors and all necessary hardware to bolt it to the vehicle at factory anchor points, and to attach it to whichever storage module is best for your build, no drilling required. If you are installing just the 60% delete you will need to own or purchase a 60% Seat Delete Bracket. name: Toyota Tundra 2022-Present 3rd Gen. DoubleCab - Second Row Seat Delete Plate System
description:
This product will require removal of factory seats for the system to be installed. The Seat Delete Plate System is does not require the removal of the factory subwoofer and it leaves the factory back wall intact.
The Toyota Tundra 3rd Generation DoubleCab Second Row Seat Delete Plate System provides a secure and flat mounting and storage solution for your vehicle.

The second-row deletes are available as a 40% Passenger Side Delete without Back Wall OR 60% Driver Side Delete without Back Wall. Ordering both 40% and 60% will create a 100% completed platform. 
The DoubleCab Seat Delete includes the Seat Delete Plate System without the Back Wall, opening the second row of the truck creating a massive platform perfect for a bike, pet, refrigerator, cargo boxes etc.
The amount of space created by removing the seats is far more than most people expect and they find that they are able to store quite a bit of gear that would normally not fit. Below the seat delete is also a great place to store heavier items, lower in the vehicle and near the middle of the vehicle for a lower center of gravity than if you were to store those items in the bed of the truck.
Seat deletes are compatible with both hybrid and non-hybrid variants.

name: Ineos - Grenadier - 2024-Present - 1st Gen - Explore Series - Drawer Refrigerator Module w/Fitted Top Plate - 19-1/4"w x 10"h x 34"d
description:
Enhance your Ineos Grenadier’s storage and convenience with our custom Fridge Drawer Module, designed specifically for the Dometic Coolmatic CD30 fridge. Built using our durable MaxLite extrusion, this unit features a Fitted Top Plate crafted from high-quality Baltic birch and finished with a rugged bed liner material for long-lasting protection.
This module integrates seamlessly with the Ineos Grenadier’s seat delete system, but requires the Rear Plate (SKU 1423-GGR-SH) for installation. Choose to install the fridge module on either the Driver’s or Passenger’s side, then add the corresponding 40% or 60% Module-Based Seat Delete to create a full sleeping platform. This system allows you to maximize both storage and sleeping space for two people while on the go.
With dimensions of 19-1/4”W x 10”H x 34”D, this fridge drawer provides ample cold storage without compromising space or function.
Installation Tip: If installing the Dometic Fridge Drawer adjacent to a storage drawer, be sure to install the storage drawer first.  The fridge drawer installation brackets allow for some adjustment, whereas the storage drawer brackets do not.
Note: The fridge does not come pre-wired for your vehicle, so professional installation or electrical expertise is recommended.
Upgrade your Ineos Grenadier with this Fridge Drawer Module, engineered for strength, durability, and a flawless fit, to transform your vehicle into the ultimate overland setup.

This L Bracket installation method means you can slide the panel forward and rearward as you so choose. For example, you simply want a clean fill panel at the front of your Canopy camper that is in close to alignment with the optional Alu-Cabin water tank. This panel can do just that. Or, lets say, you want to place a second battery or just personal gear and you need more space, the panel can be slid towards the rear of the vehicle to create a larger storage space.
The Bulkhead Panel includes the panel, hatch door and hardware to secure it to the Utility modules on both sides of the truck. It does not include the floor plate or any modules.

description:
The Alu-Cab Canopy Camper V2 Bed Plate System is the foundation of the Goose Gear Alu-Cab interior system. The Bed Plate System requires drilling into the vehicle bed for proper and safe installation. Once the Plate System is installed the user can easily add or remove AluCab Canopy Modules as needed. With integrated anchor points throughout the plate.
The Bed Plate System is base the Alu-Cab modules, but does not follow the contours of the bed walls. 
The new series of modules for the Alu-Cab Canopy Camper are lighter and more efficient than previous models. By utilizing the Alu-Cab extrusion channels we have been able to eliminate the need for back leg supports for the Utility Modules. This change saves weight, money and shipping costs.
By tying the modules to the Canopy Camper, the installer is able to get a consistent flat surface between the Utility Modules and Drawer Modules. The installation process requires the user to install spacers onto the supplied brackets for proper leveling.

The benefit of this design is that you have a convenient place to store your essential cooking gear right next to the rear door. If you have added the GP Factor drop down tables to your rear door, your cooking gear is located within arms reach of the cook.

name: Goose Gear Camper System - Chevy Colorado 2015-2022 2nd Gen - Camper 5 Ft. Bed Plate System
description:
It all starts with the Camper Bed Plate System! 
The Goose Gear Camper System Bed Plate is the first step in getting your camper ready for adventure. The Bed Plate System is designed for use with the Goose Gear Camper System Modules. 
This Plate System comes complete with pre-installed anchors for the modules for an easy bolt in system that is secure and strong. The Bed Plate System is designed and built with industrial grade plywood and coating using our propriety spray methods for superior durability and wear resistance.
Designed to Fit: Chevy Colorado 2015-Present 2nd Gen. with a 5Ft. Bed

name: IceBox 1.2 - 30" Deep Module
description:
The Goose Gear IceBox 1.2 contains a complete fridge slide integrated into a Goose Gear Module. It features a 100% extension fridge tray with Lock-In/Lock-Out capability. With the Goose Gear IceBox, you can safely store gear on top of your fridge and still have complete access without having to unload your gear to access your food.
IceBox 1.2 Specifications: 

Exterior Dimension: 19-3/16W x 22"H x 30"D
Fridge Tray Dimension:  15"W x 20"H x 28"D


The IceBox 1.2 is designed for mid size fridges such as the National Luna Weekender 50 and 52 as well as the ARB fridges up to 50qt, Engel up to 45qt, Indel B up to 40qt and SnoMaster up to 40qt. Most Fridge manufactures include the handles in the overall dimensions, as an example, the ARB 50 is 28" deep but will fit into our 25" deep tray due to the curvature of the fridge. 
Fridge NOT Included
Legacy SKUs: IB192230-BLK, IB192230-GRY

name: Alu-Cab Canopy Camper V2 - Ford Ranger 2019-2023 4th Gen. - Rear Utility Module - 5' Bed
description:
Goose Gear's Rear Utility Module is designed to install at the front of the Alu-Cab Canopy Camper. The Rear Utility Module requires the Goose Gear®  Bed Plate System and Front Utility Module to be installed for installation.
The Alu-Cab Canopy Camper are lighter and more efficient than previous models. By utilizing the Alu-Cab extrusion channels we have been able to eliminate the need for back leg supports for the Utility Modules. 
By tying the modules to the Canopy Camper, the installer is able to get a consistent flat surface between the Utility Modules and Drawer Modules. The installation process requires the user to install spacers onto the supplied brackets for proper leveling.
The Front Utility Module is not fully enclosed. Rear Utility Module or Rear Double Drawer Module can be purchased to enclose the system. 
Specifications:
Rear Utility Module Measures: 21"w x 21"hHatch Door Opening on All Rear Utility Module Top Plates Measures: 12-1/2"x w 6"d
The product options are laid out in the following format and sold separately:
Drivers Front Utility ModuleDrivers Rear Utility Module or Double Drawer ModulePassenger Front Utility ModulePassenger Rear Utility Module or Double Drawer Module
 

Image above reflects a Rear Double Drawer Module on the Passenger side and Utility Modules at all other locations. The benefit of this design is that you have a convenient place to store your essential cooking gear right next to the rear door. If you have added the GP Factor drop down tables to your rear door, your cooking gear is located within arms reach of the cook.

name: Goose Gear Camper System - Midsize Truck 6Ft Bed - Passenger Side Front Sink and Storage Utility Module
description:
The Goose Gear Camper System Front Sink and Storage Utility Module is the designed to be installed on the passenger side of the vehicle and provide you the perfect interior sink station.
Camper 6Ft Bed Plate System is required for installation. 
The  Sink and Storage Utility Module bolts directly to the Camper 6Ft. Bed Plate System.  This module is the same height as the Camper System CampKitchen or IceBox, providing a counter space.
Note: This module can not be placed on the drivers side of the vehicle. 
If the Driver Side Front Utility Module is installed, the option to add the Front Sleep Panel is available. This option will provide a platform. (See Second Image)

name: Sleep and Storage Package - Subaru Crosstrek 2018-2023 2nd Gen.
description:
The Park Series Sleep and Storage Package fully equips the Subaru Crosstrek for your next adventure. 
This all new package comes with an all new design. Park Series products are flat packed end-user assemble and install products. The Rear Plate System is now an option, it is no long required for the rear storage modules to install for this product. If you choose to forgo the Rear Plate System the rear modules secure together and then mount using factory tie down locations. If you choose to go with the Rear Plate System you will need to drill into your vehicle as well as relocate the spare tire.
